references.text: The immediate context where the angel of the Lord first stands in Balaam's way and the donkey turns off the road into a field.
The angel of the Lord moves again to a narrow place where it was impossible to turn right or left, continuing the same event with the angel in the narrow passage.
Balaam's eyes are opened and he sees the angel of the Lord standing in the way with a drawn sword, referring back to the angel's position on the narrow path.
The angel of the Lord who pursues and distresses enemies in a narrow passage, a similar motif to the angel of the Lord blocking the road.
The image of a vineyard with a fence or wall for protection; the same Hebrew word for fence (גָּדֵר) is used.
